Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error.

Designer gate (read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree (Pane (00) > flexlayoutPane_FX_CustomerPortal > Region00: header > FlexLayoutHeader > Region00: header, Region01: user; root Region01: main, Region02: footer), that no component named StaticHeader exists, and where the nested header region lies on the canvas (the left part of the teal header strip; the user region is the right part).

String collision check (T1, read-only): open Designer Edit menu > String once (Global Objects dialog, Strings filter, EXP-045/EXP-083). Filter FX_sUM as a positive control (expected one row) and then FX_sCustomerPortal (expected no row). Record both results with screenshots and leave with Cancel; verify Save is still disabled. If FX_sCustomerPortal already exists, record its value and stop blocked (the operator decides whether to reuse it).

Place, name and caption (T2): click the Static row in the Toolbox once, then click once inside the nested header region on the canvas (left part of the teal strip, away from the edges and from FlexLayoutHeader's adorner icons). Immediately record the Components tree: the new Static must be a child of FlexLayoutHeader > Region00: header. If it was placed anywhere else, click the toolbar Undo once, record the state and stop blocked. Record the generated name, type and Caption from Properties. If the canvas click does not place a component, record it and stop; never use mouse dragging. Then set Properties > Design > Name to StaticHeader (one plain fill, then Tab; at most one correction) and Design > Caption to FX_sCustomerPortal (one plain fill, then Tab; at most one correction).

String creation (T2, authorized once): with StaticHeader selected and Caption FX_sCustomerPortal committed, click the Caption row's ellipsis button once. Expected prompt: 'String FX_sCustomerPortal does not exist. Create it?' (record it verbatim); answer Yes once. If the prompt names another ID, or no prompt appears and an editor shows an existing value, change nothing, leave any editor with OK unchanged, record it and stop blocked. In the String editor confirm the Name FX_sCustomerPortal, record the pre-filled String Value (EXP-045: a generated value such as 'FX_s CustomerPortal'), replace it with Customer Portal by one plain fill and Tab (at most one correction), verify the value with a fresh snapshot and a screenshot, then OK once in the same task (never leave the editor open across tasks; it has only OK and Help). If the value cannot be set to Customer Portal, record it and stop with the editor open for the operator. Then perform exactly one Designer Save and record its response and the Save state. The canvas may keep showing the raw ID until a close and reopen (EXP-083).

Appearance and layout (T3): first verify the string read-only through Edit menu > String (filter FX_sCustomerPortal: one row with value Customer Portal), Cancel. Then reselect StaticHeader by its Components row and set: Appearance > Theme Class FX_WhiteHeader (open the list, choose it, Tab; record the classes listed); Justification Left (record the group it is in; open its list and choose Left); Layout Width 40 and Height 1.5 (the tutorial names Layout > Width and Height; EXP-062-R4 found them under Layout > Size as 'W; H'; use the rows that exist, plain fill and Tab each, and record the Size value as displayed, expected '40; 1.5'); No Colon True (EXP-062-R4: Specific Attributes; the tutorial says Miscellaneous; record the group; open the list, choose True). At most one correction per field. If a named option is missing or a field is read-only, record the available options or state, leave that field unchanged and continue with the others. Record every value as displayed after entry, then perform exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state.

Component margin (T4): reselect StaticHeader by its Components row. Find its component-level FlexLayout attributes control by hovering the canvas adorner icons on the Static (tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes' or similar; identify it by tooltip or DOM id, not by position, EXP-105). Open the dialog once and record every field before any change (expected, by analogy with FlexLayoutHeader in EXP-105: Region Index 0 and a blank Margin). Set only Margin to 2,0,0,0 (one plain fill, then Tab; at most one correction); leave Region Index and every other field unchanged. If the dialog has no Margin field or shows a region other than header, Cancel, record it and stop blocked. Record the value before OK, OK once (record any message), then exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state.

Readback (T5): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (StaticHeader under FlexLayoutHeader > Region00: header), select StaticHeader by its Components row and record Name, Caption, Theme Class, Justification, Size, No Colon and what the canvas shows for it (expected text Customer Portal without a colon). Open its component FlexLayout attributes read-only and record Margin and Region Index; Cancel. Verify the string once more through Edit menu > String (filter FX_sCustomerPortal), Cancel. Also record that FlexLayoutHeader and its regions header and user are unchanged (tree names and order). Leave the Form open and clean.

Capture screenshots of the gate and the string collision check, the Toolbox selection, the canvas and Components tree right after placement, Name and Caption after entry, the creation prompt, the String editor before and after the value, every Save response, each T3 value after entry, the component attributes dialog before and after the Margin, and the readback. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Coordinates are allowed only for the canvas placement click and the Static's canvas adorner icons when no reference exists; record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. Classify findings as observed only.
